patch_description: A fundamentally different approach: total-variation denoising (TVF) with an L1 wavelet regularizer. TVF is a sparse-derivative filter that is provably edge-preserving — it removes noise without blurring turning points, directly attacking slope_changes and false_reversals while keeping lag near zero. We solve the fused-lasso problem with a fast taut-string algorithm (O(n) in expectation), which produces a piecewise-linear estimate whose derivative changes only at statistically significant points. A wavelet-shrinkage residual polish and mild slope lead finish the pipeline. Unlike the Kalman+SG family (Gaussian smoothers that must trade lag vs. reversals), the taut string's 1D structure gives hard reversals only at genuine trend breaks.
